acceptanceCriteria: After a host compaction the adapter re-emits the packet from pinned revisions and reports non-rehydratable paths explicitly.
Hook registration is tested against the host hook API version and degrades visibly on hosts without the events.
No hook mutates repository or trace state beyond the existing bounded ledgers.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: the Claude Code adapter registers SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse and Stop; proof-carrying compaction survival is planned but unwired. Register PreCompact and PostCompact (and FileChanged where the host supports it) and rebuild the evidence packet from pinned SHAs after compaction, reporting anything no longer rehydratable. Owning spec: the Claude Code adapter contract in docs/specs and docs/specs/context-evolution-program-v0.md.
title: adapter: compaction re-pinning through PreCompact and PostCompact hooks
